purpose: Separate adopted generic-v3 absolute forecast error from errors in predicted response to feasible alternative commands at identical held-out observed histories. Diagnostic only: no fitting, updates, new closed-loop controller trial, product promotion or tolerance change.

population.interpretation: Four previously measured oracle-driven trajectories of one deterministic simulator, excluded from saved generic fitting/checkpoint selection; not an untouched controller benchmark or independent systems. Select every declared origin without looking at model errors. The public learner consumes only the latest 11 observations and 10 applied commands, with memory reset at that context start. Earlier commands are available only to the equation reference causal replay.
population.baseline_commands: The five actual issued commands at k..k+4 are a prescribed open-loop tape for this diagnostic, even though originally generated in feedback. The learner does not observe future states.

probes.formula: For one channel j, candidate[:,j] = 0.95*baseline[:,j] + 0.05*bound[j], toward lower or upper declared physical bound. Other channels unchanged. Construct and save float32 sequences with no clipping. A channel already at that bound may have zero applied change; keep it and report actual deltas.
probes.weak_response_meaning: For each output group separately, a true response norm <=1e-6 in that group units is weak; retain its absolute error, record count, and leave normalized direction/gain undefined. For full-horizon statistics flatten all five steps and use the same threshold. A predicted norm <=1e-6 additionally makes cosine undefined; its magnitude ratio and projected gain remain valid when the true response is nonweak. No exclusion based on whether the learner is accurate.

reference.implementation: Existing CascadeEquations reset and five sequential advance calls; preserve eager control conversion and compiled interval numerical boundary. Reconstruct origin state solely from declared equilibrium reset and exact issued command prefix; do not read running plant internals.
reference.baseline_check: Preserve the source trajectory numerical boundary: row 0 is the exact declared float64 initial state, independently reconstructed from the frozen initial-state seed and control manifest. Equilibrium reset converts it to the default float32 physical runtime. Require exact equality of all 320 subsequent causal canonical states to saved states[1:], and exact equality of each declared origin five-step factual forecast to its corresponding saved future states. No origin before 10 is measured.
reference.learner_contract: Use LearnedDynamics.predict with existing observed_from_state mapping: velocity[0:3], body rates[3:6], rotation entries[6:15]. No canonical position, simulator hidden state, equation coefficients or future observations enter learner inputs. Load pinned adopted v3 bytes; report actual metadata rather than old manifest recipe label.
reference.precision: Default float32 learner and physical reference, matching runtime; x64 only within inherited archive/context loading. No optimizer calls or planning precision changes.

metrics.absolute: Component RMSE and mean Euclidean group-vector error at each of five horizons, for factual baseline separately and all seven sequences. No cross-unit aggregate.
metrics.response: Subtract each predictor own baseline forecast from its alternative forecast. For all six probes at each horizon and full five-step flattened group vector: RMS vector response error; per-probe cosine; magnitude ratio ||learned_delta||/||true_delta||; signed projected gain dot(learned_delta,true_delta)/||true_delta||^2; relative response error ||learned_delta-true_delta||/||true_delta||. Report counts and median/p10/p90 for normalized statistics and fraction with negative projected gain. Include per-command/sign and pooled six-probe summaries.
metrics.aggregation: Report each of four trajectories plus pooled fixed origin roster. Summaries are descriptive correlated observations, not confidence bounds. Retain zero/tiny responses and invalid pairs as explicit denominators. All absolute errors and true-response magnitudes remain in physical group units.
metrics.action_size: Report actual perturbation max absolute size and RMS in each physical command channel, plus fully inactive sequence counts; do not treat equal interpolation fractions as equal physical command steps.
metrics.failures: Keep every declared origin and sequence. Preserve nonfinite predictions or forecast exceptions as failed slots, store NaN numeric output with explicit failure records; report total, valid and invalid comparison counts. Valid-subset error metrics never imply failed cases passed. A source trajectory replay mismatch is a harness failure, not learner evidence.

evidence.save: Exact input snapshots and frozen protocol, environment, model fingerprint/recipe, all origins, past observations/commands, seven future command sequences and actual deltas, learner forecasts, oracle observed forecasts and canonical future states, failure records, per-trial/pooled report, complete file hashes.
evidence.verify: Validate frozen protocol/source/input bytes and exact roster. Freshly reconstruct every source trajectory and recompute all 868 learner/reference forecasts, saved deterministic arrays, failures and report. No refitting. Rehashed altered inputs and altered derived outputs must be rejected.
evidence.acceptance: Accept a complete reproducible diagnostic including failures. learner_changed=false, controller_changed=false, application_qualified=false. No numerical result authorizes promotion in this iteration.

validation: Feasible channel-isolated probes, bound and inactive edge cases; no clipping or hidden-state learner inputs.
Direction reversal versus amplitude-only error; error growth across horizons; weak/zero responses and invalid denominators.
Causal origin/history/future alignment, exact factual trajectory replay and fingerprint provenance.
Complete artifact roster, exact fresh replay, actual rehashed tamper rejection, focused inherited API tests and Ruff.
stop_rule: Measure this single frozen roster once, replay and challenge artifacts, then record the dominant measured weakness and one next named gap. No amplitude/window/seed sweep, learner fitting, controller modification, or post-result selection of origins.
